epic.title: Epic #568 — spine ownership and lifecycle
epic.intent_and_why: Make engine state know where it belongs and who owns it, then make lifecycle and consumers rely on that substrate.

definition_of_done: Every epic issue is dispositioned with evidence.
Ownership and location facts are enforced by the engine rather than advisory subprocess checks.
Each wave is reviewed and replanned from observed evidence.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: No check that cannot register its own failure; no silent waiver; independent review before promotion.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: A failing pre-fix repro, passing focused and full Linux suites, exact forge state, and comparative Windows evidence while main remains red.
good_enough.appetite: One serialized engine-core issue in wave 1; later work requires a refreshed contract.

hard_constraints: Agents interact with spines through MCP, not the engine CLI.
Engine-core edits are serialized one Commander at a time.
The contract expires at the wave-1 merge.
fixed_decisions: A spine stores origin.worktree at creation.
The engine compares its own cwd to the stored origin and falls back for origin-less legacy spines.
Windows-only failures are accepted for this wave by explicit human ruling; Linux failures are not waived.

current_wave.objective: Land engine-native worktree isolation against a stored spine origin and remove the command check that could not fail.
exit_criteria: The engine enforces its own cwd against that origin.
The obsolete init.c0 command check is deleted and behavior tests replace coverage-script tests.
Independent review approves and post-promotion Linux verification is green.

issues.title: Engine-native worktree isolation against stored spine origin
issues.desired_outcome: Isolation is an engine invariant and cannot be bypassed by telling a subprocess where to stand.
issues.useful_now: It is the location substrate consumed by the remainder of epic #568.
issues.appetite: One serialized Commander with bounded rework.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: Red-first repro, independent APPROVE, focused tests, full suite, and verified merged SHA.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose internal threading while preserving the stored-origin and engine-owned comparison decisions.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not edit spine_rail.py or agent_work_root.py.
Do not split the write and read sides.

wave_forecast.why_likely: The remaining ownership issues consume the substrate wave 1 landed.

uncertainty_register.unknown: Which remaining tranche the human wants next and with what latitude.
uncertainty_register.current_evidence: The existing contract says it expires at the wave-1 merge.
uncertainty_register.next_probe: Ask the human to ratify a refreshed contract before launch.

parked_possibilities: WP7 latitude pre-clearance and CLI hardening
